name: owner-statement
title: Draft owner operating statement
for_each: select id,name from property.owners order by code

sections.title: Lease schedule
sections.note: Recorded annual rent only. This is not a trust account statement or distribution instruction.
sections.sql: select tenant,property,currency,annual_rent_cents,end_on from property.lease_register where owner=(select code from property.owners where id=$1) order by code

sections.title: Charges and recorded receipts
sections.sql: select code,name,currency,amount_cents,received_cents,balance_cents,due_on,reconciled_on,receipt_reference from property.balances where owner=(select code from property.owners where id=$1) order by due_on

sections.title: Outgoings recovery
sections.sql: select code,currency,recoverable_cents,recovered_cents,variance_cents from property.recovery where owner=(select code from property.owners where id=$1) order by code

name: rent-review
title: Draft rent review brief
for_each: select id,name from property.reviews where status='pending' order by code

sections.title: Review terms
sections.note: Internal brief, not a served notice. Check the executed lease and agreed calculation before any notice or rent change. CPI values and market valuations must be supplied.
sections.sql: select l.tenant,l.property,l.currency,l.annual_rent_cents current_annual_cents,r.proposed_annual_cents,r.method,r.notice_by,r.due_on,l.lease_reference from property.reviews r join property.lease_register l on l.id=r.lease_id where r.id=$1

name: outgoings-reconciliation
title: Draft outgoings reconciliation
for_each: select id,name from property.leases order by code

sections.title: Recorded allocation
sections.note: Amounts must be checked against invoices and the lease or disclosure authority. Positive variance is unrecovered; negative variance is an over-recovery for review.
sections.sql: select name,period_start,period_end,currency,cost_cents,recovery_pct,recoverable_cents,recovered_cents,variance_cents,authority_reference from property.recovery where lease_id=$1 order by code

name: work-order
title: Draft maintenance work order
for_each: select id,name from property.maintenance where status='open' order by code

sections.title: Work requested
sections.note: Draft only. Confirm contractor availability, insurance and access arrangements before sending.
sections.sql: select m.code,m.name,u.name unit,p.address,m.contractor,m.priority,m.due_on,m.insurance_until from property.maintenance m join property.units u on u.id=m.unit_id join property.properties p on p.id=u.property_id where m.id=$1
